notes.title: Dev Vlogs and Other Media
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

In an effort to increase parity with our other social channels, we will be posting updates to this section of the Steam Forums as we release Dev Vlogs and other content. Below we've included the current catalog of public Dev Vlogs and other videos, as well as links to our Twitter and Patreon pages. 

Thank you for supporting our development journey!
